nodes.name: Record reply and response draft in Odoo

parameters.content:
## Inbound behavior
Exact In-Reply-To / outbound Message-ID wins. Sender fallback is accepted only for one Odoo candidate. Ambiguous or unmatched messages create a deduplicated Odoo review item. IMAP does not mark messages read before durable handling. Hard bounces suppress the address. Replies create a response draft for unsuppressed contacts but never send it.
